# Optiline Mada

> French-speaking outsourcing and fully managed teams in Madagascar for international companies.

Optiline Mada builds and manages dedicated teams in Madagascar for international companies.
Recruitment, workspace, equipment, HR, local supervision and administration are handled by Optiline Mada —
clients manage the work, not the logistics.

Core offer: dedicated teleconsultant teams (from €690 / month), dedicated developers (from €1,290 / month),
dedicated assistants (from €590 / month). English, French and Malagasy-speaking collaborators,
with additional languages available depending on the market.

## Key facts

- Capacity: 3,000 scalable workstations, 6,000+ agents across 2 shifts.
- Connectivity: up to 10 Gbps dual-fiber Internet with backup connection and power backup.
- Operations: 24/7 coverage possible; time zone UTC+3, 1–2 hours ahead of Central Europe.
- Languages: French widely spoken (administrative language), English growing, Malagasy native.
- Team with 25+ years of international experience; 10+ industries served.
- Legal framework: Malagasy Law No. 2014-038 on personal data protection; GDPR for European clients.

- [Call Center & Customer Service](/services/call-center): Inbound and outbound customer operations.
